question: In Head and Neck trials, from the secondary endpoint text flag if immune-related adverse events (irAEs) were explicitly assessed.

steps.desc: Filter Head and Neck trials and select secondary endpoint text.
Map free text to boolean flag for irAE assessment.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Secondary endpoint and output JSON {NCT, PMID, irae_assessment}. Set irae_assessment to true if the text explicitly mentions immune-related adverse events (irAEs) or immune-related toxicity; otherwise, set it to false. JSON only.
